title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks
purpose: Help the user understand an important agent-evaluation paper without reading the full paper.

output.audience: An informed non-specialist reader following current developments
output.format: Well-structured prose with descriptive headings and optional sparing bullet points

strengths: Direct relevance to agentic work and software-development workflows
Peer-reviewed venue and a methodologically rich benchmark paper
Requires compression across design, results, interpretation and limitations
Contains quantitative results and distinctions between task, model and agent-system performance
limitations: English-to-German output combines comprehension, translation and summarization
Only the main paper is included; detailed appendix evidence is deliberately out of scope
The reported model baselines are historical results from the frozen 2025 paper version
